newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine pension funds managed $7.03 bln in May.
newsitem.headline: Argentine pension funds managed $7.03 bln in May.

text.p: The funds managed by Argentina's private pension system rose to $7.03 billion in May, the Superintendency of Pension and Retirement Funds said Thursday.
A month earlier the funds managed $6.59 billion and in May 1996 they had $3.63 billion.
The Superintendency said in a release that of the funds managed, $3.19 billion, or 45.4 percent of the total, were invested in Argentine government bonds. That compared with $3.06 billion in April.
Stocks accounted for $1.48 billion, or 21.1 percent of funds invested in May, compared with $1.15 billion a month earlier.
Funds invested in fixed term deposits came to 16.7 percent or $1.17 billion compared with $1.09 billion in April.
The funds held $146 million in cash at the end of May, up from $99 million at the end of April.
